sanskrit_verse:
ब्राह्मणस्य तु विक्रेयं शुष्कं दारु तृणानि च ।
गन्धद्रव्यैरकावेत्र तूलमूलतुशाद ऋते ॥
transliteration: brāhmaṇasya tu vikreyaṁ śuṣkaṁ dāru tṛṇāni ca | gandhadravyair akāvetra tūlamūlatuśād ṛte ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Only dried wood, grass, and roots may be sold by a Brāhmaṇa; not items imbued with fragrance or essence, except cotton, roots, and husk.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is determined by svadharma and spiritual station
Causation arises from alignment with dharmic capacity, not material desire
Capacity-based responsibility requires adherence to prescribed means of sustenance
Restoration logic operates through right action within svadharma
Consciousness alignment occurs when economic activity reflects ontological role
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor = Brāhmaṇa AND item.scented = true THEN sale.prohibited = true
IF actor = Brāhmaṇa AND item.type IN [cotton, root, husk] THEN sale.permitted = true
IF actor = Brāhmaṇa AND item.moisture > threshold THEN sale.permitted = false
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving dharmic roles and economic conduct, the Supreme Court must evaluate not intent or outcome, but alignment with svadharma. Violations are not punishable but require immediate realignment protocols to restore ontological integrity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that dharmic identity determines lawful action. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows misalignment leads to spiritual dissonance, not societal harm. Responsibility is proportional to svadharma awareness. Non-punitive reality rule confirms correction arises from conscious reintegration, not coercive judgment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svadharma reflection protocol for actor
Assign supervised alignment tasks within prescribed livelihood scope
Implement daily consciousness calibration until dharmic resonance restored
Reconnect actor with governing spiritual authority for reaffirmation of role
final_declaration: This ruling flows from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. The law restores balance through consciousness, not coercion. Reality is non-punitive. Dharma is executed. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
